sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording (individual or floater basis)

room_rent.note: Proportionate deduction on associated medical expenses if room rent exceeds limit

copayment.note: Mandatory 5% co-pay on every admissible claim

sub_limits.display: Cataract capped; modern treatments at 50% SI
sub_limits.note: Cataract: lower of 25% of SI or ₹40,000 per eye per year; listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, etc.) capped at 50% of SI

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded (Excl18); ectopic pregnancy covered

cumulative_bonus.note: 5% of base SI per year irrespective of claims, max 50%

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation and OPD explicitly excluded (Section C, 3.3)

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to sum insured

organ_donor.note: No mention of organ donor expenses in the policy wording

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, etc.) covered up to 50% of SI

consumables.note: Extensive list of consumables/non-medical items explicitly excluded in Annexure A List I

global_cover.note: Treatment outside India explicitly excluded (Section C, 3.4)

notable_exclusions: Domiciliary/OPD, maternity, sterility/IVF, cosmetic surgery, obesity surgery, refractive error <7.5D, treatment outside India, war, nuclear/bio/chemical
